Best USB4 40Gbps NVMe SSD enclosures (November 2026)

After searching current listings and independent reviews, my top choices are OWC Express 1M2 for overall quality, UGREEN 40Gbps for value, and ZikeDrive Z666 for maximum speed.

One important distinction: 40Gbps is the interface's advertised bandwidth, not the actual SSD transfer speed. A good USB4 enclosure typically delivers around 3,000–3,800 MB/s, depending on the SSD, computer, and controller.

What matters most

Controller: Look for ASMedia ASM2464PD if maximum USB4 performance is your priority. Older Intel JHL7440-based designs can be slower.

Cooling: A large aluminum heatsink matters during sustained transfers of hundreds of gigabytes.

Compatibility: Check whether your computer supports USB4 40Gbps or Thunderbolt 4. A regular USB-C port may be much slower.

SSD: A PCIe 4.0 NVMe drive is a sensible pairing. Confirm that its physical dimensions fit.

Cable: Use a certified 40Gbps cable, preferably the included one.

My recommendation

At around $100, I'd buy the OWC Express 1M2 for a dependable everyday enclosure. If maximizing benchmark speed is your main goal, I'd consider the ZikeDrive Z666 instead.
